entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A deaf owlin bard-student at Strixhaven University who joined Silverquill College and can conjure images and emotions in others' minds.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where Abigale studies.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Abigale's home plane.

entities.name: Silverquill College
entities.description: The Strixhaven college Abigale joins.

entities.name: Dellian Fel
entities.description: Professor of a poisonous flora course whose harsh tutelage led Abigale to drop out.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: Teaching assistant who guided the students to Harrier's Wood.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: Abigale's classmate, kidnapped by an elven hunter in the Gilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: Abigale's classmate.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: Abigale's classmate who asks Brigid for shelter.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf who joins Strixhaven's cross-planar program and later completes the ritual calming the Dawning Archaic.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: A moon-headed elemental on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor accidentally woken by the students, whose passing turns day to night.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: Isilu's sun-headed twin, woken by Abigale to restore balance.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A kithkin who explains Lorwyn to the students and offers hospitality; a former companion of Maralen.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Queen of the faeries and a former companion of Brigid.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Planeswalker who accompanies the students through an Omenpath back to Arcavios.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who suspects Jace Beleren is behind the Archaics' disruption.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker Chandra believes meddled with the Archaics.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: Oracle kidnapped by the Dawning Archaic; later disappears into wild magic with Tam.

entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: An Archaic that emits reality-warping magic after kidnapping Jadzi.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane the students are lured to through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Portals between planes used by the students.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: Kithkin village that Isilu turns from Lorwyn to Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: Site where the Dawning Archaic appears and a chasm opens.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Maralen's palace the students seek.

events.summary: A faerie lures Abigale, Kirol, Sanar and Tamira through an Omenpath from Harrier's Wood to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
events.quote: a faerie appeared and lured Abigale, along with her classmates Kirol , Sanar , and Tamira , through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .

events.summary: The students accidentally wake the moon-headed elemental Isilu in a cave; fleeing, darkness floods the world and turns day to night.
events.quote: They found the moon-headed creature, the elemental Isilu , in a chamber beyond the carvings and accidentally woke it.

events.summary: The students meet the kithkin Brigid Baeli, and night erases the Omenpath they came through; she offers them hospitality.
events.quote: She introduced herself as Brigid Baeli .

events.summary: Brigid takes them to Goldmeadow, where Isilu turns the village to Shadowmoor and they flee toward Glen Elendra to seek Maralen.
events.quote: Isilu walked past the village, turning a place that had been in Lorwyn for years into Shadowmoor.

events.summary: Abigale flies the others across the Wanderwine River; in the Gilt-Leaf Wood Kirol is kidnapped by an elven hunter unnoticed.
events.quote: Kirol was kidnapped by an elven hunter

events.summary: Abigale falls into a tributary, is carried to merrows who take her to the sleeping Eirdu, who leads Isilu to its twin and restores balance between night and day.
events.quote: She led the elemental to its twin, and the balance between night and day was restored.

events.summary: The students accompany Ajani through another Omenpath back to Arcavios; Lluwen joins Strixhaven's cross-planar program.
events.quote: the students accompanied Ajani through another Omenpath

events.summary: Abigale joins Silverquill College and takes a posting at the Forum of Amity.
Summoned to Titan's Grave, Abigale helps investigate the Dawning Archaic that kidnapped Oracle Jadzi; Chandra blames Jace, and the Archaic drags them all into a chasm.
events.quote: the students and planeswalkers fell into a chasm beneath Titan's Grave along with it.

events.summary: Tam disrupts Jadzi's calming ritual, casting them both into wild magic and making them disappear; Lluwen finishes the ritual with his friends and the Lumarets to stop the Archaic.
events.quote: Lluwen was forced to finish the ritual himself

relations.quote: queen of the faeries and a former companion of Brigid's
along with her classmates Kirol , Sanar , and Tamira
